title: Page 88
transc:
Ft. Monroe Apr 24 . 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Image grapes unity the diamond a very fast
piloted block aid runner is I am told about
to be sold in France Zodiac if she is 
sold she will certainly be in the old business
zebra I think she ought to be seized particularly
as we are so much in want of vessels
Youth Nankin Rebecca how do you like that plan
Geo D Sheldon


Ft Monroe April 25th 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Brutus I am receiving a large number of permits
for various none Commissioned Officers & privates to appear before
a board of Examination for Commissions in Whartons & also
to attend a free Military school for the same purpose
unity I respect fully ask permission to retain these spit
till the Close of the Spring camp pain Yoke Knocks
Geo D Sheldon


Ft Monroe Apr 25 . 1864
Maj Eckert Di
Have had conference with Knocks Pekin must
have ghost spoons wrangle Matt aerial ready
to put up at a moments notice .
and mandate spoons ready if tarquin answer
Geo D Sheldon
